description:
PetGrow is an artificial grass brand focused on creating cleaner, greener, and lower-maintenance outdoor spaces for pets, families, and everyday living.

Our products include artificial grass for yards, pet areas, balconies, patios, DIY projects, putting greens, and more. We offer multiple pile heights and custom-size options to fit different spaces and customer needs.

Affiliates earn 8% commission on eligible sales generated through their unique affiliate link or approved coupon code. Approved affiliates may also receive a personalized 10% off coupon code to share with their audience.

We welcome content creators, influencers, bloggers, pet-focused publishers, home and garden creators, DIY enthusiasts, and other partners who can introduce PetGrow through authentic and helpful content.

Great promotional ideas include before-and-after transformations, product reviews, installation videos, pet-friendly outdoor spaces, backyard makeovers, patio and balcony projects, and other real-life uses of artificial grass.

PetGrow values honest, accurate, and high-quality promotion. Misleading advertising, unauthorized coupon distribution, brand bidding, spam, and other prohibited promotional practices are not allowed.
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid monthly via PayPal or bank transfer. Referral orders are reviewed for refunds, cancellations, fraud, and other ineligible activity before payout.
term_and_condition:
PetGrow Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

By applying to and participating in the PetGrow Affiliate Program, you agree to the following terms:

1. Eligibility and Approval

All affiliate applications are subject to review and approval by PetGrow. We reserve the right to accept or reject any application at our discretion.

2. Commission

Approved affiliates earn 8% commission on eligible sales generated through their unique affiliate link or approved coupon code.

Commission is calculated based on the eligible product subtotal only. Taxes, shipping fees, shipping taxes, tips, refunds, canceled orders, and other non-product charges are excluded.

3. Tracking

Affiliate referrals may be tracked through affiliate links and approved coupon codes. The standard tracking cookie period is 30 days.

PetGrow is not responsible for commissions that cannot be tracked due to deleted cookies, browser settings, tracking restrictions, incorrect links, or other technical factors outside our reasonable control.

4. Self-Referrals

Affiliates may not earn commission on their own purchases or use the program primarily to obtain personal discounts.

5. Returns, Refunds, and Cancellations

Commission will not be paid on refunded, canceled, fraudulent, disputed, or otherwise ineligible orders. If commission has already been recorded for such an order, it may be adjusted or reversed.

6. Promotional Practices

Affiliates must represent PetGrow accurately and honestly. False claims, misleading advertising, spam, trademark misuse, impersonation, or other deceptive promotional methods are not allowed.

Affiliates are responsible for following all applicable advertising and disclosure requirements, including clearly disclosing their affiliate relationship when required.

7. Paid Advertising

Affiliates may not bid on PetGrow brand terms, trademarks, or misleading variations of the PetGrow name in paid search advertising without prior written approval.

8. Coupon Use

Only coupon codes officially approved or assigned by PetGrow may be promoted as affiliate offers. Affiliates may not publish unauthorized coupon codes or promote expired offers.

9. Payments

Eligible commissions are subject to review before payment. Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information.

PetGrow may delay or withhold payment while investigating suspected fraud, policy violations, returns, disputes, or other unusual activity.

10. Program Changes and Termination

PetGrow may update commission rates, program rules, payment terms, or other program conditions when necessary.

Either PetGrow or the affiliate may end participation in the program at any time. PetGrow may suspend or terminate an affiliate account for violations of these terms.

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and agreed to these terms and conditions.
